evidence.description: getTimerInterval obtains investment statistics directly from Statistics.shared.
totalInvestedAt reads three values from Statistics.shared rather than an explicitly supplied dependency.

candidates.explanation: InvestmentsProjection directly accesses the Statistics singleton to obtain operational data for its timer and investment calculations. The service is not supplied through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The projection stores the task in timerTask.
Although the closure initially captures self weakly, the guard creates a strong self reference before the repeating loop and retains it throughout the task's lifetime.
Cancellation occurs in deinit, which cannot run while the repeating task retains the owner.

candidates.explanation: The stored task promotes weak self to a strong reference before entering its repeating loop. That reference remains alive across iterations and suspensions, creating an owner-to-task-to-owner retention cycle. The visible cancellation path depends on deinitialization, so it does not independently terminate the task or break the cycle.
candidates.title: Task Ownership Retain Cycle
